spec.text: Image 1 is the man's model sheet, image 2 the woman's model sheet, image 3 a real photo of the Taipei Guest House, image 4 the approved art style. Recreate the ornate white Western-style mansion from image 3 at night, softly lit, behind a black iron fence with a tree-lined sidewalk in front, in the warm matte clay and gouache storybook style of image 4, deep blue night sky, warm street lamps. The SAME couple in their casual outfits walk side by side along the sidewalk in side view, their inner hands just about to touch, full bodies about four heads tall. Cinematic 16:9. No readable text, no extra people, no photorealism.
